units: Num. R. s. 96 (ref. to Num. V, 12) תשטה תשטה כתיב בשין … עד שיכנס בה רוח ש׳ (not בה הש׳ …) it is written with Shin so that you may read thishṭeh, to intimate that a woman will not go astray, unless the spirit of insanity has entered into her; Sot. 3ᵃ אין אדם עובר עבירה … רוח ש׳ no man sins unless &c.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00608"><he>מוֹרָא</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 9:2:10">Y. Naz. IX, 57ᵈ</cite> <he>אדיין</he> … <he>עומד בשְׁטוּתוֹ</he> Bar P. still insists upon his foolish opinion.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 5b:5">Bekh. 5ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>שטים</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 25:1">Num. XXV, 1</cite>) <he>שנתעסקו בדברי ש׳</he> they were engaged in foolish things; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:12">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 34:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIV</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 3:11">Koh. III, 11</cite>) <he>כל מה … אבל הש׳ וכ׳</he> whatever thou hast made, thou hast made well, but insanity, which thou hast created, of what avail is it before thee?; a. fr.
